name: 33853 · Lake Wales, FL
findings: ZIP 33853 (Lake Wales) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33853 (Lake Wales) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33853 (Lake Wales) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
